slogan: Find local home-service professionals, post jobs, compare quotes.

positioning.one_liner: Describe the job once. Unlock relevant local pros. Compare clear quotes.
positioning.enemy: Calling company after company without a clear scope or comparison.
positioning.candor: We do not choose the contractor for you. You compare scope, availability, proof and price.

offer.headline: Turn one project brief into a shortlist of relevant local pros.
offer.subheadline: Less chasing. Better context. Clearer quotes.
offer.price_anchor_text: One clear project brief can replace hours of repetitive outreach.
offer.guarantee_text: No fake guarantees: you stay in control and decide who earns the job.
offer.urgency_text: Project timing matters. Share your target date so available pros can prioritize correctly.

lead_engine.lead_magnet_subtitle: Know what to ask before you compare contractors.
lead_engine.referral_prompt: Know someone planning a home project? Share the directory and save them the contractor-call marathon.

proof_points: Direct company requests + open job board
